description: Read status and console output; no console input, power operations, file changes or administration.

Manage the application: lifecycle, updates, console commands, game files, module settings and actions. Resolves module rights from the selected application catalog. No AMP account/role administration or AMP configuration-file editing.

Full AMP authority in the selected scope, including current and future module permissions. Uses the supported API all-nodes grant, not an enumerated catalog. Requires a bootstrap administrator already holding all-scope authority.
